lobbying_activities.description: Advance Wireless Spectrum clearing and relocation efforts for T-Mobile licenses across the country; general lobbying for support for H.R. 5793 the "Cell Tax Fairness Act of 2008" in the House and S. 3249 the "Mobile Wireless Tax Fairness Act of 2008" in the Senate; general lobbying for support for the MOBILE Cell Phone Act of 2008 (S. 2668 and H.R. 5450); note that H.R. 5450 was passed by the House in April 2008 as part of Chairman Rangel's "Taxpayer Assistance and Simplification Act of 2008" (H.R. 5719); General assistance with drafting a portion of the 2009 Economic Recovery Stimulus package - specifically the provision to expand broadband internet access so businesses in rural and other underserved areas can link up to the global economy; general lobbying on concerns with  the Advanced Wireless Services-3 band plan, specifically as it relates to the AWS-1 spectrum and interference concerns; general lobbying on H.R. 7207--The Spectrum Relocation Improvement Act, H.R. 6320, The 21st Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act, and S. 3420, The Open Wireless Internet Act; general lobbying to ensure access to wireless services and broadband in the Washington Metropolitan Area Transit rail system; lobbying and lobbying activities related to consumer protection issues in the House and Senate Commerce Committees, such as phone trafficking, H.R. 1776--The Call Center Consumers' Right to Know Act, and H.R. 3402, The Calling Card Consumer Protection Act.
